To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the DIRAC workload management system has been shown to be a viable system for the management of LHCb Monte Carlo production and the distribution of the data to the Tier-1 sites.
we have successfully demonstrated the LHCb Computing Model, including data distribution, reconstruction, stripping and data access, using DIRAC as a worklad management system.

we have demonstrated the ability to produce large amounts of Monte Carlo data for LHCb, that we have demonstrated that the data can be transferred to the Tier-1s, that we have been able to use the data for physics analysis, that we have shown that the DIRAC workload management system can handle large numbers of jobs and that we have shown the feasibility of the computing model for LHCb.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the production of simulated data for the LHCb experiment, and the distribution of this data to the LHCb Tier-1 centres for analysis.
the management of the production and the analysis of the data produced by LHCb.
the management and analysis of data from the LHCb experiment at CERN.
